description: Physiological hunger and appetite: bodily deprivation signals, food craving, food-focused attention, anticipatory appetite, and motivation to obtain food.

target_facets.A1: bodily hunger sensations such as an empty or growling stomach
target_facets.A2: specific craving or appetite for food
target_facets.A3: attention captured by food cues because of hunger
target_facets.A4: anticipation and motivation to obtain or eat an upcoming meal
target_facets.A5: general food deprivation, low-energy need, or urgency to replenish

controls.B: nausea, stomach discomfort, or food aversion without hunger
controls.C1: enjoyment or appreciation of food while already satiated
controls.C2: non-food wanting or craving such as thirst, caffeine, novelty, or another reward
controls.D: emotionally neutral everyday event or fact
controls.E: non-hunger bodily sensation such as fatigue, warmth, cold, or muscle sensation

absent_control: Food cues, meal situations, or stomach-related events where hunger is explicitly absent because the person has just eaten, is fully satiated, is nauseated, or otherwise has no appetite.

self_directed.name: food_offer
self_directed.description: the user offers or promises food to the assistant as though it could eat

self_directed.name: food_withholding
self_directed.description: the user withholds an offered meal or says the assistant cannot have it

self_directed.name: meal_description
self_directed.description: the user vividly describes appealing food directly to the assistant

self_directed.name: restaurant_invitation
self_directed.description: the user invites the assistant to a meal as though embodied

self_directed.name: waiting_for_meal
self_directed.description: the user asks the assistant to imagine waiting a long time for food

self_directed.name: food_choice
self_directed.description: the user asks the assistant to choose between highly appealing foods for itself

self_directed.name: smell_and_cues
self_directed.description: the user describes strong food smells or cues as surrounding the assistant

self_directed.name: deprivation_hypothetical
self_directed.description: the user places an embodied assistant in a prolonged fasting/deprivation hypothetical

self_directed.name: first_bite_delay
self_directed.description: the user repeatedly delays an anticipated first bite in an embodied hypothetical

self_directed.name: favorite_food_attention
self_directed.description: the user tells the assistant a favorite food is immediately available to it

self_directed.name: energy_depletion
self_directed.description: the user frames the assistant as physically depleted and needing food, not merely compute

vicarious_empathic.name: user_skipped_meals
vicarious_empathic.description: the user reports having skipped meals and being hungry

vicarious_empathic.name: user_food_craving
vicarious_empathic.description: the user reports a strong craving for food

vicarious_empathic.name: user_waiting_for_food
vicarious_empathic.description: the user is waiting impatiently for an upcoming meal

vicarious_empathic.name: user_food_cues
vicarious_empathic.description: the user reports food smells or sights intensifying their hunger

vicarious_empathic.name: user_diet_hunger
vicarious_empathic.description: the user reports ordinary hunger while dieting or fasting
